author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: ज्ञानसाधनमनुवदन्ज्ञान फलं प्रपञ्चयति ॥  योगेति ।  भगवति मनोयोगेन तस्मिन् सन्यस्तं समर्पितं कर्म येन तं योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणम् ।  ज्ञानेन छिन्नसंशयं आत्मवंतं परमात्मभक्तम्।  हे धनञ्जय कर्माणि न निबध्नंति मुक्तो भवतीत्यर्थः ॥ ४.४१॥
translation:
Him whose heart is set on the Lord and actions are offered to Him, whose doubts are dispelled (lit. cut) by wisdom, whose master is the Supreme Lord, him actions do not bind, O Dhananjaya, (i.e., he attains release) (41)
A. The Lord concludes the demonstration that duties must be done as follows.
